identity.response_shape: one assistant message, rendered per input.output_contract
identity.sandbox_use: grader side only; the python_unit scorer runs candidate source in src/swarm/tools/sandbox_runner.py after the observation is complete
identity.rationale: an observation that can call tools measures the harness as much as the model. Holding the tool surface at zero keeps an exact_model_config the only thing that varies between cells.

binding: every counted held-out observation must quote this tool_protocol_id; an observation taken under any other tool surface is not comparable and must not be counted
